entities.summary: Matthäus Hipp also spelled Matthias or Mathias was a German clockmaker and inventor who lived from 1852 on in Switzerland. His most important, lastingly significant inventions were electrical looms, traffic signals, pendulum clocks, and the Hipp chronoscope.
